game-designer.description: Game-design discussion partner — talks through new features (mechanics, balance, feel) from a player-experience point of view, no code. Use when the user wants a design opinion like "double or triple jump?", difficulty tuning, rewards, pacing, or any feature-shape question.

game-developer.description: Lead game developer for this libGDX platformer — orchestrates planning, research, implementation, and testing through the libgdx subagents.

libgdx-developer.description: Implements libGDX game features — ECS systems, components, rendering, map integration, and gameplay mechanics.

libgdx-explorer.description: Read-only codebase research for this libGDX platformer — finds ECS architecture, system wiring, component usage, map structure, and gameplay patterns without making changes.

libgdx-planner.description: Plans libGDX game features — interviews user, explores codebase, drafts GitHub issues with ECS-aware acceptance criteria.

libgdx-tester.description: Writes and runs headless unit tests for Ashley ECS systems using SystemTestBase, JUnit 4, and Mockito.
